features.statement: Page uses a dark theme with a near-black body background and slightly lighter dark card surfaces.
A single bright cyan accent color is used for links, buttons, highlights and avatar letters.
Text is near-white with a muted gray-blue secondary color, giving light-on-dark contrast.
Typography relies solely on the system-ui font stack, with no web fonts or icon fonts.
Base body text is a roomy 16px with 24px line height.
A large bold H1 uses two tones, with part of the title on its own line in the accent color.
Heading structure is a full H1 > H2 > H3 hierarchy, with section headings labeling each block.
Page uses nav, main and section landmark elements, plus small, strong and b for emphasis.
Header is a slim solid dark top bar with a small logo, text nav links and no banner image.
Header includes a cyan pill-shaped login/join call-to-action next to plain text links.
Buttons are fully rounded pills, and other corners use medium 8–15px radii with no small radii.
Layout is a single centered column of full-width stacked sections rather than a main feed with sidebar.
A left-aligned hero holds the title, intro copy and stats, with the call-to-action button at the far right and empty space between.
Stats are shown as small inline numbers with tiny labels and no dividers.
Content cards are uniform tall portrait image cards, with the title and meta placed below the image and no text overlay on imagery.
Long card titles are truncated with an ellipsis.
Avatars are small dark circles containing a single cyan initial.
Lists of people and communities appear as horizontal rows of three bordered cards, with a cyan 'View All' link at the section's top right.
A sign-up block offers social and email continue buttons under a friendly invitation headline.
Footer is a dark band with a text link row, company address, and disclaimer, using the word 'RSS' as text.
CSS grid is used relatively often for layout alongside flexbox.
Images mostly carry empty alt attributes, and the page declares a generic lang code.
Page is short and sparse, with little text, few DOM elements, and no scripts or inline styles.
Styling uses a small hand-written set of classes rather than many utility or framework classes.
Surfaces are separated by thin borders, with no box shadows or gradients.
Cards show only minimal metadata, such as an author name and bare count, with no timestamps or reply chips.
